CONTROLS (I = hide)

W/S forward/back · A/D turn (camera follows) · Shift sprint · Space jump · mouse turns (click game), right-drag looks around · C crouch
J/click punch · K kick · E grab/enter/exit · F throw package / drop weapon · T wear/remove 👻 ghost costume (buy at Spooky Sheets, $120)
Q eat (num num num!) · G/right-click throw snack (food splats!) · X belly flop (in air) · R reset/flip · M mute · L low graphics
Cops & crime: 🦛 Squish Meter (hearts, top-right) drains from foam-baton bonks & tackles — only a KO gets you BUSTED, and it refills when you stop getting hit. Crimes only count if someone sees them: a ❗ witness runs off to phone the cops (bonk them first!), cops who see it call it in instantly. E-bikes are rubber: they bounce off walls and plow through everything else.
🛒 Hippo Mart: E at a checkout ring to buy groceries · E near a shelf item to grab it (leave without paying = shoplifting!) · E near a cart to ride it, E again to hop off · 🛡 tanks are armored: use shells, missiles & explosions
🌭 Hot Dog Gun (hidden in a random house — look for sparkles!) & 🚀 Bazooka (Hangar 2 at Fort Chonk, ammo crate next to it): pick up with E, aim with the camera, hold J/click to fire (🎮 X · 📱 FIRE), F drop
💼 Jobs: E at a blue NOW HIRING sign (Hippo Burger cook, Hippo Mart stocker, depot delivery driver, crossing guard by the school crosswalk) · follow the green ring · E at the sign again to clock out · 3 strikes (or stealing from work) = FIRED
🐙 Octopus: a rare goofy octopus waddles by now and then — grab it with E (🎮 RB · 📱 ✋) before it poofs for +$500!
🏚 Buildings can be blown up (shells, missiles, bazooka, car bombs, big rams) — a construction crew rebuilds them
🚗 Traffic: E at a moving car's door to carjack it (the driver won't be happy)
Driving: W/S gas/brake · A/D steer · Space handbrake · H horn
Controller: LS move/turn · RS camera · A jump · X punch · Y kick · B crouch (driving: exit) · RB grab/enter · LB throw/drop · RT eat · LT throw snack · LS-click sprint · D-pad ↑ Belly Boom, → Snout Slam, ↓ Hippo Flip, ← belly flop (air) · Menu pause · View ghost costume (if owned, else controls)
Controller driving: RT gas · LT brake/reverse · LS steer · A handbrake · Y horn · B exit · D-pad ↑ flip
Specials: Belly Boom: hold S 1s → W+J · Hippo Flip: hold C 1s → W/Space+K · Snout Slam: C→C+W→W+J

HIPPO EXPRESS

🦛 Totally Unreliable Delivery Service 📦

🎮 Controller connected — D-pad/left stick picks a hippo, A starts. In game: LS move/turn · RS camera · A jump · X punch · Y kick · RB grab/enter · RT gas / LT brake when driving · Menu pause · View 👻 ghost costume
📱 Touch controls ready! Left thumb: move & steer · right side: swipe to look + tap the buttons · 🎮 Bluetooth controller works too
Tip: tap Share ⬆ → Add to Home Screen to play full-screen like an app

On foot

W/S forward/back · A/D turn · Shift sprint · Space jump
Camera follows behind you. Mouse: click the game, then move to turn; right-drag to look around; wheel = zoom
J/left-click punch (or swing weapon) · K kick · C crouch
E grab package / weapon / enter + exit vehicles
F throw package or drop weapon · Q eat a snack
G/right-click throw snack · R back to depot · I help · M mute

Driving

W gas · S brake/reverse · A/D steer
Space handbrake (drift!) · H horn (siren in cop car)
E exit · R flip back over
Vehicles: delivery van, sedans, cop car, warp-speed e-bikes (~240 km/h!), sand rail + trophy truck (try the Mud Flats east of town — cop cars hate dirt!)
👻 Ghost costume: buy at Spooky Sheets ($120), T wear/remove — cops lose track unless you do crimes · 🚔 Cops can be bonked (3 hits), dazed cops = pursuit break, but they call backup!

Special moves

Belly Boom: hold S ~1s, then W + J
Hippo Flip: hold C ~1s, then W or Space + K
Snout Slam: C → C+W → W (quarter-circle) + J
Belly Flop: in the air press X (or J+K, or C+J)
Bad behavior = ★ wanted stars. Hide out of sight to lose the cops (stars fade slowly now!).
🌭 Hot Dog Gun hidden in a house · 🚀 Bazooka at the army hangar · hold J to fire
💼 Jobs: E at a blue NOW HIRING sign

📱 TOUCH CONTROLS (tap to close)

Left thumb: joystick — up walks, left/right turns · push past the ring to sprint · steers when driving
Swipe the right side: turn & look around
👊 punch / swing weapon · 🦶 kick · ⏫ jump · ✋ grab / pick up / buy / drive · ⏬ crouch (hold)
⭐ specials: 💥 Belly Boom · 🤸 Hippo Flip · 👃 Snout Slam · 🧇 Belly Flop (WAFFLES!) · press 👊+🦶 together in the air to flop too
🌭/🚀 FIRE (hold) when holding the Hot Dog Gun or Bazooka — aim by swiping · ✋ also starts/clocks out of 💼 jobs, does job tasks & carjacks traffic
📦 throw package / 🫳 drop weapon · 🍩 toss a snack · 😋 eat · 👻 wear/remove ghost costume
Driving: ▲ GAS / ▼ BRAKE (press higher on the pedal = harder) · 💨 drift · 📯 horn · 🔄 flip · 🚪 exit
🎮 A Bluetooth Xbox controller works too — the buttons hide when it's in use.
